Hi Alex — great to kick this off. I pulled a first-pass MAP draft and attached it (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx). High-level proposal below — please confirm owners and any hard freezes (procurement/legal) on your side.

Proposed milestone timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (Dec 6): Project kickoff, stakeholder alignment — owners: Mina (Redwood), Alex (Caldera) — deliverable: agreed MAP and weekly sync cadence.
- Week 2 (Dec 20): Sandbox integration + data schema validation — owners: Eng leads (Caldera eng-oncall, Redwood infra) — deliverable: successful sample ingest and basic inference run.
- Week 4 (Jan 3): End-to-end UAT with Clinical Ops — owners: Tessa (CS), Caldera Clinical Ops lead — deliverable: UAT checklist signed.
- Week 6 (Jan 17-21): Pilot go-live (limited cohort) — owners: Tessa/Infra on-call — deliverable: Pilot acceptance and success metrics (latency < 400ms p95, error rate < 1%).
- Week 10 (Feb 14): Production scale & cutover plan — owners: Monica (eng operations)/Caldera ops — deliverable: Production deployment runbook and SLO acceptance.

Open items and asks:
1) Procurement path: Karthik — can you advise on typical contract lead times for Caldera-size deals and whether we can bundle a 30-day pilot clause?
2) Security questionnaire: Alex, send SOC2 + encryption Qs to security@redwoodinference.com; I’ve CC’d Karthik to help prioritize vendor questionnaires.
3) Weekly cadence: propose Tuesdays 10:00 PT starting Dec 8 (30 min).

I’ll plan to update the MAP-draft with owners you confirm and share a HubSpot link and a DocuSign SOW summary once Legal has sign-off. If Jan 11 is critical, flag now — otherwise Jan 18 is our conservative recommendation to allow legal/procurement time.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx

Best,

Sara from Caldera is asking whether we can include a 30-day pilot clause and a small onboarding credit to offset their initial integration costs. My read: it's reasonable for a strategic healthcare pilot, but we should cap credits and tie them to measurable milestones (e.g., UAT sign-off). Proposed approach: 15% onboarding credit applied if pilot goes live and passes UAT by Jan 21; credit expires at go-live. Also recommend we reserve a dedicated infra slot for the pilot for 4 weeks around Jan 18 to guarantee latency SLOs.

If you both sign off, I’ll propose the 15% clause and include the credit terms in the SOW summary (one-page) and share with Sara. Adding Karthik to thread for procurement timing.
